entries.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft. Lying on a flat bench with the head toward a low pulley, feet on the floor; the upper arms point at the ceiling and stay there while the elbows bend to lower the bar to just above the forehead, then straighten, with a pause at the top. The cable runs from the pulley past the end of the bench to the bar without crossing the bench or the head, and only lengthens as the arms straighten. Not drawn: the narrow overhand grip, which a side view cannot show.
entries.summary: Lying on a flat bench with the head toward a low pulley, lower the bar to just above the forehead by bending only the elbows, then straighten the arms and pause.

frames.caption: Lie on a flat bench with your head toward a low pulley and hold the bar with a narrow overhand grip, arms straight above the chest.
Keeping the upper arms still and the elbows in, bend the elbows to lower the bar until it is just above the forehead.
Elbows in, upper arms pointing at the ceiling.
Straighten the elbows to return the bar above the chest.
Pause with the arms straight above the chest.

entries.name: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 22 degrees so the flat bench, both dumbbells held with palms facing each other, the frozen upper arms angled slightly back over the head, and the deep lowering of the dumbbells beside both ears all read clearly: lying on a bench with dumbbells pressed over the chest and palms facing in, keeping the upper arms frozen just past vertical while bending the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside the ears, and pressing back to long arms along the same path.
entries.summary: Lying on a bench with dumbbells pressed over your chest, palms facing each other, and upper arms frozen slightly back over your head, bend the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your ears and press back to long arms along the same path.

frames.caption: Lie on a bench with dumbbells pressed over your chest and palms facing each other, upper arms angled slightly back over your head.
Keeping your upper arms frozen and pointing at one spot on the ceiling, bend the elbows to lower the dumbbells.
Lower the dumbbells deep and controlled beside your ears while the elbows point at the ceiling.
Press back along the same path with the upper arms acting as the stationary hinge pin.
Return to long arms over the chest with the palms facing each other and upper arms angled just past vertical.

entries.name: Lying Triceps Press
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 22 degrees so the flat bench, the rigid medium overhand grip on the EZ bar, both tucked elbows, and the bar stopping just above the forehead all read clearly: lying on a flat bench with arms straight above the chest, keeping the upper arms and tucked elbows still while bending the elbows to lower the bar slowly until just above the forehead, and straightening the elbows to return the bar above the chest.
entries.summary: Lying on a flat bench holding an EZ bar with a medium overhand grip, arms straight above the chest and elbows tucked in, keep the upper arms still and bend the elbows to lower the bar slowly until just above the forehead, then straighten the elbows to return above the chest.

frames.caption: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar with a medium overhand grip, elbows tucked in and arms straight above the chest.
Keeping the upper arms and elbows still, bend the elbows to lower the bar slowly toward the forehead.
Lower the bar until it is just above the forehead with the elbows tucked in and upper arms still.
Straighten the elbows to press the bar back up along the same path.
Return the bar to straight arms above the chest with the elbows tucked in and the upper arms still.

entries.name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 18 degrees so the high pulley behind the kneeling athlete, the sideways bench supporting the head and the backs of both upper arms, the narrow overhand grip on the straight bar, and the extension to level with the floor all read clearly: kneeling facing away from a high pulley with the head and upper arms resting on the bench and elbows bent, straightening the elbows until the arms are level with the floor, pausing, and letting the elbows bend slowly back to the start.
entries.summary: Kneeling facing away from a high pulley with the head and the backs of the upper arms resting on a sideways bench and the elbows bent on a narrow-grip straight bar, straighten the elbows until the arms are level with the floor, pause, then let the elbows bend slowly back to the start.

frames.caption: Place a bench sideways in front of a high pulley, kneel facing away from the machine, rest the head and the backs of the upper arms on the bench, and hold the straight bar with a narrow overhand grip and the elbows bent.
Keeping the upper arms on the bench and close to the head, straighten the elbows until the arms are level with the floor.
Pause and squeeze the triceps at full extension with the elbows in and the upper arms staying on the bench.
Let the elbows bend slowly back toward the starting position while keeping the upper arms on the bench.
Return slowly to the bent-elbow start with the head and the backs of the upper arms resting on the bench.
